io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide

Class GuidePath

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.GuidePath

  • public final class GuidePath
extends java.lang.Object
    Describes where an item lives in the guide: the buttons a player clicks to reach it, and the page it sits on once there.

    The route depends on the active layout, so this reads the viewer's own setting rather than assuming one. Categorized goes category then that addon's section; classic goes the addon's menu then the group.
